worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.summary: Attacks everything around it by causing an explosion, and the user faints upon using it. Foes in the ring are thrown outward and lifted, and the ground is left scorched; even a blast that hits no one takes the user down. Focused blast is harder and narrower, spread blast is wider and faster.
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.use.0: Trade one life to blow open a surround
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.use.1: Blast a close foe away, body and all
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.use.2: Detonate on a very short wind-up before foes step away
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.use.3: Deal one last heavy blow before going down
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.descripti: Each target in the ring takes about %1$s explosion damage; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit (a Ghost is immune to the blow, but the user still faints).
The blast reaches %1$s blocks; that ring is the ground it covers.
Those caught are thrown %1$s blocks outward and lifted at %2$s blocks/tick.
Change up to %3$s ground blocks and restore them after %2$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.focus.on: Focused blast: power about x1.28, the blast narrows to x0.74 and wind-up is -2, at cooldown +6.
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.focus.off: Spread blast: the blast spreads x1.18, wind-up +2 and cooldown -6, at about x0.88 power.
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP and a %4$s s cooldown is committed on cast. The user faints once it is used.
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s, the reach to %3$s blocks and the debris to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.selfdestruct.preferenc: On (focused blast): power about x1.28, the blast narrows to x0.74 and wind-up is -2, at cooldown +6 - for hammering one priority target. Off (spread blast): power about x0.88, the blast spreads x1.18, wind-up +2 and cooldown -6 - to cover a crowd. Either way the user goes down.
Beyond this distance the companion will not walk in to detonate; it is a point-blank move.
At least this many visible, living targets must stand in the ring before it self-destructs; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to detonate at a single target.
Below this fraction of its own health the companion lowers the blast threshold to one target; higher makes it go down fighting sooner.
